live.checked_in: {name} has arrived ({time}) and is in the waiting room.
live.with_doctor: {name} ({time}) is being sent in to you now.
live.indicator_off: Live updates are paused — the page refreshes every minute
live.feed_lead: Show a doctor's DocBook appointments in Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook on their phone.
live.feed_privacy: Each appointment appears only as its time, the word “Appointment” and the first letter of the patient's first name — no phone numbers, services, notes or medical information. Anyone who has the address can read these times, so keep it private. Rotate it if it was shared by mistake, or turn it off.
live.feed_none_text: Your account is not linked to a doctor. The clinic manager can turn on subscriptions for doctors.
live.feed_rotate_confirm: The current address will stop working at once. Calendars subscribed with it must be subscribed again with the new address.
live.feed_disable_confirm: The address will stop working and the appointments will disappear from subscribed calendars at their next refresh.
live.feed_never_used: Not read by any calendar yet
live.feed_howto_google: On a computer, open Google Calendar → Other calendars → + → From URL, paste the address and choose Add calendar.
live.feed_howto_apple: iPhone: Settings → Calendar → Accounts → Add Account → Other → Add Subscribed Calendar. Mac: File → New Calendar Subscription.
live.feed_howto_outlook: Outlook: Add calendar → Subscribe from web, then paste the address.
live.feed_refresh_note: Calendar apps decide how often they read the address: Apple and Outlook usually within an hour, Google can take several hours. DocBook itself always shows the current schedule.
live.feed_enabled: The calendar subscription is on. Copy the address into the calendar app.
live.feed_rotated: A new address was created. The previous one no longer works.

calimport.title: Import from a calendar
calimport.lead: Bring appointments from Google Calendar, Outlook or Apple Calendar into DocBook. You review every event before anything is saved.
calimport.preview_lead: {n} events between {from} and {to}, shown in the clinic's time zone.
calimport.result_lead: Here is what was imported and what was left out.
calimport.source_file_meta: Exported from Google Calendar, Outlook or Apple Calendar
calimport.file_help: Up to 5 MB. A Google export is a .zip — open it and choose the .ics file of the calendar you need.
calimport.url_help: Must start with https://. DocBook reads it once for this import and does not keep it.
calimport.range_help: Only events in this range are listed (up to one year). Past times are never imported.
calimport.mode_one: Put every event on one doctor's schedule
calimport.mode_keyword: Choose the doctor from words in the event
calimport.keyword_help: An event goes to the first doctor whose word appears in its title, description or location. Separate several words with commas.
calimport.fallback_none: Leave without a doctor (choose in the review)
calimport.nothing_saved_yet: Nothing is saved until you confirm the review.
calimport.howto_google_1: On a computer, open Google Calendar → Settings (gear icon).
calimport.howto_google_2: For a file: Import & export → Export. For an address: open the calendar under “Settings for my calendars”.
calimport.howto_google_3: Copy “Secret address in iCal format” and paste it here.
calimport.howto_outlook_1: Calendar → Share → Publish calendar, then copy the ICS link. Or save the calendar as an .ics file.
calimport.howto_apple_1: On a Mac, select the calendar, then File → Export → Export… to save an .ics file.
calimport.rule_no_double: A doctor is never booked twice at the same time. Clashing events are shown and left out.
calimport.rule_once: Each event is imported only once, even if you import the same calendar again.
calimport.rule_patients: Patients are recognised by the phone number in the event; otherwise the event title is kept as the patient's name.
calimport.rule_recurring: Daily and weekly repeating events are imported one by one; monthly and yearly repeats are listed but not imported.
calimport.stat_outside_meta: Outside working hours or no doctor
calimport.stat_skipped_meta: Already imported, past, all-day or cancelled
calimport.truncated: Only the first {n} of {total} events are shown. Choose a shorter date range to import the rest.
calimport.empty_text: The calendar has no events between these dates. Try a wider range.
calimport.preview_hint: Tick the events to import. You can change the doctor of each event.
calimport.name_only: Name only — no phone in the event
calimport.allow_outside: Also import times outside working hours or on days off (never over another appointment)
calimport.nothing_selected: Select at least one event to import.

state.conflict_file: Clashes with another event in the file

errors_live.CAL_TOO_BIG: The calendar is larger than 5 MB. Export a shorter period or a single calendar.
errors_live.CAL_NOT_ICS: This is not an iCalendar (.ics) file. Choose the .ics file exported from your calendar.
errors_live.CAL_SOURCE_MISSING: Choose a calendar file or paste its private address.
errors_live.CAL_URL_INVALID: This address cannot be used. Paste the private https:// address of the calendar.
errors_live.CAL_FETCH_FAILED: The calendar could not be downloaded from this address. Check that it is the private (secret) address and try again.
errors_live.CAL_TIMEOUT: The calendar server did not answer within 15 seconds. Try again, or upload the .ics file instead.
